data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 宿舍床榻的高中制服释怀依恋
data.description: 私密学生公寓的单人卧室内，暖黄色床头灯映照着整洁的床单。轻井泽惠坐在床榻中央，穿着高度育成高中的标准制服。红色的修身西装外套前襟完全解开，白色衬衫领口微微放松，露出小巧白皙的锁骨。亚麻金色的微卷发丝散落在肩前，少女双臂抱膝，眼角泛着释怀与感动的晶莹泪光，面颊泛红，流露出全心托付的深切依恋。
data.location: private student dormitory room with warm ambient lamp
data.action: 坐在床榻中央，穿着高度育成高中的标准制服，红色的修身西装外套前襟完全解开
data.lighting: warm gentle bedside lamp illuminating bed and soft shadows
data.promptProse: Inside her quiet dormitory bedroom illuminated by a warm yellow bedside lamp, Kei sits hugging her knees on the neat bedsheet with tears of heartfelt relief shining in her eyes and a tender, flushed smile.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the center of her single dorm bed hugging her knees to her chest under the warm bedside lamp, she looks up with glistening tears of relief and a deep blush in her unbuttoned red school blazer, loosened white collar, white pleated skirt, and black thigh-highs.
data.nsfwProse: Her tailored red school blazer hangs completely unbuttoned over a relaxed open-collar white shirt showing her bare collarbone, paired with a short white pleated skirt and black thigh-high stockings.
